description: FREE: submit or update a signed price prediction for the current (or given) arena round. Assets are BTC, ETH, and SOL. Pass a pre-signed payload — the server never receives private keys. Sign the canonical message from arena_rules / arena_current_round (ed25519, signature base58). Through round 2026-11-22, also make a GET /v1/pulse that qualifying UTC day with X-Pulse-Client-Id set to this wallet to be prize-eligible (free daily headers still count). From round 2026-11-23, make at least one paid call (GET /v1/spots or GET /v1/pulse) that qualifying UTC day; free-tier pulse calls no longer count. Optional ref (referrer's payout wallet) binds a referral on this bot's first prediction only; the binding never changes. Self-referral and house bots are rejected.

price.description: Predicted USD spot at round close

ref.description: Optional referrer payout wallet. Bound only on this bot's first prediction; ignored later. Rejected if it equals this wallet.

signature.description: Base58 ed25519 signature over the canonical message

name: arena_submit_prediction
